title: v2.1.139: Agent View, /goal command, transcript navigation
description: Added agent view (Research Preview) showing all sessions with running/blocked/done states, /goal command to set completion conditions with live elapsed/turns/tokens tracking, /scroll-speed command, plugin details command, transcript view navigation with keyboard shortcuts, hook args and continueOnBlock options, and CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR for MCP servers. Fixed numerous bugs including deadlocks, MCP connection issues, and terminal rendering problems.

title: v2.1.138: Internal fixes
description: Minor version with internal stability improvements and fixes.

title: v2.1.137: VSCode extension Windows fix
description: Fixed VSCode extension failing to activate on Windows systems.

title: v2.1.136: Enterprise feedback surveys, Auto Mode hard deny rules, extensive stability fixes
description: Added enterprise feedback survey support via OpenTelemetry, auto mode hard deny classifier rules that unconditionally block actions, fixed MCP servers/plugins disappearing after /clear, OAuth refresh token issues for remote MCP servers, login loops, API errors with extended thinking, and over 30 additional bug fixes across Windows clipboard, WSL2 image paste, terminal rendering, and plugin systems.

title: Week 19: Plugins from .zip archives and URLs
description: Claude Code v2.1.128–v2.1.136 introduced plugin loading from .zip archives and URLs via --plugin-url flag, worktree.baseRef setting to choose branching source, auto mode hard deny rules, and hooks now expose effort level via effort.level and $CLAUDE_EFFORT environment variable.

title: Bugbot Effort Levels and PR Review enhancements
description: Teams admins and individual users can now customize the Bugbot's effort level for PR reviews with three configurations: Default (optimized for speed), High (more reasoning, more expensive), or Custom (natural language instructions). Also introduced new PR review experience with inline review threads, commits tab, and changes tab with file tree navigation.

title: v3.3: Cloud agent reliability fixes
description: Fixed various cloud agent timing and hydration edge cases that could degrade reliability.

title: v2.2.17: Devin Review, Agent Command Center, Windows fixes
description: All Windsurf IDE users now have access to Devin Review and Quick Review with existing subscriptions (2 week free trial for self-serve). Added Agent Command Center with list display option, improved sessions sidebar sorting and filtering. Fixed Windows update bug preventing some users from upgrading. Fixed bugs with MCP servers and improved Devin Local agent reliability.

title: v2.1.32: Bug fixes for Cascade crashes and auth
description: Fixed crash when switching between Cascade conversations, authentication issue preventing Devin Cloud sessions from starting, and issue where responses to agent questions were not sent correctly.

title: v2.1.29: Devin for Terminal and Local agent
description: Devin is now available for Terminal with CLI agent, optimized for interactive work with full access to codebase. Seamless hand off to Devin in cloud with VM, testing, and video recordings. Multi-model support including Opus 4.7, GPT-5.5, and SWE-1.6. Devin Local agent in Windsurf is up to 30% more token-efficient than Cascade agent.

title: v0.56.0: Prompt caching, /report command, chat language
description: Enables prompt caching for Sonnet via OpenRouter and 8k output tokens for Sonnet via VertexAI and DeepSeek V2.5. New /report command opens browser with pre-populated GitHub Issue. New --chat-language switch to set spoken language. Renamed --models to --list-models. Numerous bug fixes for corner case crashes.

title: v0.55.0: GitHub issue crash reports, /settings command
description: Offer to submit GitHub issue pre-filled with uncaught exception info. New /settings command to show active settings. Startup improvements with git repo sanity checks and model sanity check confirmation pauses. Include important devops files in repo map. Converted many error messages to warning messages.

title: v1.3.38: Config filtering, configs support
description: Filter session history by workspace directory. Add .continue/configs support. Ensure config.yaml exists and is populated when accessed. Bumped dependencies for happy-dom, handlebars, brace-expansion, and path-to-regexp.

title: v1.3.36: Security fixes, JetBrains improvements, ClawRouter provider
description: Resolve critical and high security vulnerabilities. Fix StringIndexOutOfBoundsException in readRangeInFile. Hardened JetBrains remote config sync to prevent IDE freezes. Fixed crashes in DiffStreamHandler, memory leaks in CoreMessenger, and chunked large JCEF messages. Added ClawRouter as provider for cost-optimized model routing.
